subject: AWS co-sell: Sylvan Health - intro & onboarding runway
messages:
From: Jordan Myers <jordan.myers@aws-partners.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: Matt O'Connell <matt.oconnell@amazon.com>
Date: 2027-09-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: AWS co-sell intro to Sylvan Health (new opportunity)

Hi Karthik,

Quick one — Sylvan Health (payer/provider analytics) is interested in evaluating LLM-powered inference for their clinical summarization pipeline. I'm the AWS partner lead working with their account team. They asked if Redwood can be introduced as a potential co-sell partner and to have a short kickoff to align on technical fit and commercial motion.

Key contacts:
- Alyssa Ramos, Head of Platform (alyssa.ramos@sylvanhealth.com)
- Ben Carter (AWS field seller) is looped on the opportunity as well — I cc'd Matt from the AM team.

Can you do a 30-minute intro next week? Suggested asks: short product fit, data residency and SOC2 overview, and a mutual action plan outline. I attached an initial MAP draft (Sylvan_MAP_v0.2.pdf) that the AWS team started.

Thanks — Jordan

[Attachment: Sylvan_MAP_v0.2.pdf (PDF, 245KB)]

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Jordan Myers <jordan.myers@aws-partners.com>, Alyssa Ramos <alyssa.ramos@sylvanhealth.com>
Cc: Matt O'Connell <matt.oconnell@amazon.com>
Date: 2027-09-01T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: AWS co-sell intro to Sylvan Health (new opportunity)

Jordan / Alyssa — thanks for the intro. Happy to run a short hello and outline a straightforward onboarding runway. Proposed agenda (30m):
1) Intros & goals (5m)
2) Product fit + typical architecture slide (10m)
3) Security/compliance & data residency (7m)
4) Mutual next steps / MAP alignment (8m)

Proposed times (PDT): Tue 2027-09-07 10:00am or Wed 2027-09-08 2:00pm. Alyssa — which works?

I've attached our SOC2 summary and a one-pager tech snapshot that usually helps customers. If Sylvan has a procurement runway doc, please share and we'll align the mutual action plan.

Karthik Iyer
Senior Strategic Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0194

[Attachment: RDW_SOC2_Summary.pdf (PDF, 128KB)]

From: Alyssa Ramos <alyssa.ramos@sylvanhealth.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, Jordan Myers <jordan.myers@aws-partners.com>
Date: 2027-09-02T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: AWS co-sell intro to Sylvan Health (new opportunity)

Hi Karthik / Jordan,

Thanks — Tue 9/7 at 10am PT works for us. We'll aim to keep it to 30 minutes. A couple quick notes from our side so we can use the time efficiently:
- Procurement: we are on a compressed Q4 procurement runway — procurement will want an indicative SOW and any typical term highlights (data retention, breach notification timelines, indemnity scope).
- Security: SOC2 is a checkbox; we also need to understand how token-level logs are retained and access controls for shared environments.
- Data residency: our PHI-adjacent data stays in us-east-1.

I'll add our Platform Architect (internal) to the call once we confirm time. For now please send the calendar invite and any short pre-read — we prefer < 2 pages.

Best,
Alyssa Ramos
Head of Platform, Sylvan Health
alyssa.ramos@sylvanhealth.com

(We didn't attach a formal procurement doc yet; will share before the call.)

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: Jordan Myers <jordan.myers@aws-partners.com>, Alyssa Ramos <alyssa.ramos@sylvanhealth.com>
Date: 2027-09-02T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: AWS co-sell intro - Sylvan Health (tech enablement request)

Laura — forwarding the thread. Sylvan confirmed Tue 9/7 10am PT. Can you join as our technical lead and be prepared to cover:
- Short architecture slide (3–4 bullets) showing deployment patterns we recommend in AWS (VPC private deployment + KMS/HSM options),
- Token-level logging & retention policy (slides + where to find in the console),
- Typical onboarding timeline for a pilot (30 days: eval -> PoC -> procurement).

I attached the SOC2 summary we shared. Also please review Sylvan_MAP_v0.2.pdf Jordan sent and suggest any modifications to the MAP (we should keep this tight).

Thanks — Karthik

[Forwarded attachment: Sylvan_MAP_v0.2.pdf]
[Attachment: RDW_SOC2_Summary.pdf]

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, Jordan Myers <jordan.myers@aws-partners.com>, Alyssa Ramos <alyssa.ramos@sylvanhealth.com>
Date: 2027-09-03T15:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: AWS co-sell intro - Sylvan Health (tech enablement request)

Thanks for the heads up — I'll be on the Tue 9/7 10am PT call. Quick notes I will cover (high level):
- Deployment options: hosted API (fastest), dedicated capacity (predictable throughput), private VPC (for PHI-adjacent workloads). Will call out data plane residency — we support AWS regions; recommend us-east-1 for latency and compliance.
- Logs & retention: token-level logs are configurable per-customer; default retention 30 days with enterprise options for longer retention and secure export to customer S3.
- Pilot -> production: typical pilot (2–4 weeks) with a small test set, then a 30–60 day integration window depending on procurement.

I'll upload a 1-slide tech snapshot and a concise agenda doc to the calendar invite.

Laura Bennett
Senior Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai

[Attachment planned: aws_copilot_agenda.docx]
Note: Calendar invite created (https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abc123_sylvan_intro) and HubSpot deal RDW-AWS-2027-0098 linked.
